title: Composition operators between model and Hardy spaces
summary: Let $n\ge 1$ and $\varphi: \mathbb{D}^n\to\mathbb{D}$ be a holomorphic function, where $\mathbb{D}$ denotes the open unit disk of $\mathbb{C}$. Let $Θ: \mathbb{D} \to \mathbb{D}$ be an inner function and $K^p_Θ$, $p>0$, denote the corresponding model space. We obtain characterizations of the compact composition operators $C_\varphi: K^p_Θ\to H^p(\mathbb{D}^n)$, $1<p<\infty$, where $H^p(\mathbb{D}^n)$ denotes the Hardy space.
